key_concepts: Mimosa pudica folds its leaves when touched
Mimosa pudica is locally known as Makahiya
Leaf folding in Mimosa pudica may serve as a defense against herbivores
Plants respond to stimuli such as touch
Plants adapt to drought, floods, strong winds, poor soil nutrients, and extreme cold
Plants in the Philippines have adaptations for specific unfavorable conditions
Plant adaptations help them survive in their environments
Plant adaptations help maintain plant diversity and ecosystem resilience
Camouflage is an adaptation for survival
Animals use colors or patterns to blend in with their surroundings
Camouflage helps animals avoid predators or ambush prey
